change_policy: This manifest and the collector-ui-design-standards-v1.0 tag are immutable historical records and must never be rewritten; future corpus state may legitimately diverge from v1.0. Post-freeze normative changes go through normal governance and result in a new standard, a versioned revision, a supersession, or a retirement.
